body:
## Summary

- require `macos-hardware-compatibility` evidence to map retained files to explicit artifact roles before a row can pass
- update the schema, tests, runbook, and tools docs with the required Host/Android/runtime/visual evidence role contract
- refresh the existing 2026-08-31 blocked Mac16,8 current-base evidence summary so it exposes the remaining runtime-only missing roles without closing the gate

## Verification

- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility -v`
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v`
- `make evidence-tools-test` (1441 tests)
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> exit 0, `aggregate_verdict=blocked`, `can_mark_phase0_stable_release=false`
- `make macos-hardware-compatibility-gate EVIDENCE_DIR=docs/changes/2026-08-21-host-signing-tcc-preflight/evidence/2026-08-31-macos-host-compatibility-current-base-codex-task-blocked` -> Make exits 2 because the tool writes `verdict=blocked`; summary now lists missing artifact roles `android_device_identity`, `android_runtime_log`, `host_runtime_log`, and `visual_stream_evidence`
- `adb -s <redacted-adb-serial> reverse --list` -> no output
- `git diff --check`
- `python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/macos_hardware_compatibility.py tools/tests/test_macos_hardware_compatibility.py`
- `shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-21-host-signing-tcc-preflight/evidence/2026-08-31-macos-host-compatibility-current-base-codex-task-blocked/SHA256SUMS`

## Boundaries

No Vibe Screen, MacHost, or Telemachus GUI was launched. No `swift run` command was used. No TCC, Keychain, or System Settings state was modified. No `adb reverse` mapping was created; only `adb -s <redacted-adb-serial> reverse --list` was used to confirm the current reverse list was empty. This PR does not claim Phase 0 is stable/complete/shipped and does not close the macOS Host hardware compatibility matrix.
title: test: harden macOS Host compatibility artifacts
